paragraphs.text: Kaylen was a Dwarven hero of considerable skill and rank from Sarpadia on Dominaria .

Not much is known of his life beyond the fact that his lover was the human Tymolin Loneglade . When an Orc - Goblin army invaded their homeland Tymolin and Kaylen struggled to hold back the waves of invaders. Kaylen was eventually struck down from behind by an orc and died with Tymolin by his side.
